title: Make scout and forge resumable with partial-result preservation
question_or_target: Target: a scout or forge run that is interrupted preserves everything it had proven and resumes from there. Acceptance: killing forge mid-run leaves a truthful partial artifact on disk (every unproven claim marked UNKNOWN - not yet measured), because a unit that holds results in memory for 70 minutes and then freezes is a measured total loss on this estate.
answer: Scout and forge share tools/workflow_foundry/resumable.py: a write-as-you-go runner that seeds every claim as UNKNOWN, proves one claim, fsyncs a schema-valid partial artifact, then continues. A cooperative kill at 30% (3 of 10 claims) leaves PARTIAL with seven explicit UNKNOWN / not-yet-measured rows. Resume loads the IMP-0145 checkpoint (completed ids + receipt hashes + open nodes + param bindings) and skips claims whose receipts still pass the oracle; the ledger counted 7 resume dispatches against 10 for a clean run. A memory-only negative control leaves no file on the same kill; a naive restart re-dispatches all 10. SUCCESS:IMP-0215

evidence.claim: A kill at 30% leaves a parseable, schema-valid artifact whose unproven sections are marked UNKNOWN.
The resumed run does not re-do proven work: ledger dispatch count is strictly lower than a clean run, and resume ids are disjoint from killed proven ids.

negative_controls.description: MemoryOnlyEngine proves claims in RAM and writes only on COMPLETE. The same kill-at-30% leaves no file. The write-as-you-go engine leaves a PARTIAL with UNKNOWNs.
ignore_checkpoint=True re-dispatches the full roster (count 10, not lower). Honest resume dispatches 7.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 counts dispatch events from the append-only ledger and does not trust probe 1's proven-id list or the runner return value. Naive restart and oracle-tamper are both-states controls.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0209 scout search and IMP-0212 forge synthesis are not this unit. This substrate is the resume/partial contract those engines must use; live marketplace/paper search is UNKNOWN here.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Wire IMP-0209/IMP-0212 prove_claim to real search and fusion.
